messages:
Maria G.: Quick async check — who is owning the v2 client compatibility matrix for the public SDK rollout? Need a single owner for final sign-off before we freeze headers.
Dan R.: I can own the matrix, Maria. Planning to update rows for language SDKs + + feature flags today.
Sophia L.: Thanks Dan. Can you also add a column for 'behavioral diffs' (prompt/response shape) vs just status? PMs keep asking.
Dan R.: Yep will add a `behavior_diff` column. Also linking the tentative rollout schedule: canary next Tue, broad on Thu if no regressions.
Kevin H.: Heads-up: storage team has a dependency on the new streaming header. If the header is required we need a shim for older proxies.
Maria G.: Which header exactly? we debated `Accept` vs `Redwood-API-Version` last week.
Kevin H.: It's `Accept: application/vnd.redwood.v2+json` in the current plan. Some proxies strip custom Accept params.
Jordan (deploy-bot): deploy-bot: canary build queued — job id 8942 — will run smoke tests once artifacts are ready.
Alex P.: Kevin — if proxies strip it the fallback is `Redwood-Api-Version: 2` (short header). Storage can accept that, engineering-side change minimal.
Samir: Quick SDK note — we bumped the default client to use v2 for Node and Python in the beta branch. We added an opt-out env var: REDWOOD_API_VERSION=1
Maria G.: Perfect. Dan — when you update the matrix, can you mark SDKs that default to v2 vs explicit opt-in? We need that for release notes.
Dan R.: On it.
Sophia L.: Also tagging @security — do we have any security review items for the new header parsing? We might need to sanitize header values (parsing vectors).
Maria G.: Good call. @security — ping (I can escalate if needed).
Kevin H.: One more blocker: telemetry team will flip ingestion schema on Wednesday morning. If we can't guarantee zero-downtime, they want a 48h freeze window.
Dan R.: Can we move the canary to Wednesday after telemetry flip? Jordan, what's the ETA for the canary job artifacts?
Jordan (deploy-bot): deploy-bot: artifacts will be built in ~40m, canary deploy can be scheduled to any window after.
Samir: If we shift, we should also coordinate SDK release PRs. I can hold the Node/Python release until after canary pass.
Alex P.: Ops ask — please include a clear rollback plan in the rollout doc: which tag to revert to and how to toggle `REDWOOD_API_VERSION` in prod routes.
Maria G.: Agreed. Dan — add rollback steps and a checklist for canary smoke (latency, 95th, error spikes, response shape diff).
Dan R.: Will do. Quick snippet I'll add to the docs for header negotiation:

```
# client headers (prefer)
Accept: application/vnd.redwood.v2+json
# fallback (for proxies)
Redwood-Api-Version: 2
```

Maria G.: Nice. Sophia — can you draft the behavioral diff test cases? A handful of prompts that historically diverged between v1 and v2.
Sophia L.: Yep, I'll drop 8-10 test prompts into the eval suite and tag them `v2-rollout`.
Kevin H.: After we finalize the matrix I can run a proxy pass-through test from staging to production-like infra.
Jordan (deploy-bot): deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled for 2024-06-05T18:30Z (if accepted) — will post logs here.
Samir: Small ask — add a line in the SDK changelog about the opt-out env var and the header fallback. Helps customer support.
Maria G.: Good. Last item: who is the escalation owner during canary? Suggest Alex P. on primary, Dan R. backup.
Alex P.: I can be primary for the canary window.
Maria G.: OK closing loop: Dan owns the matrix + rollback doc, Sophia owns behavioral diffs, Samir gates SDK release, Alex owns oncall for canary, Kevin validates proxy path, Jordan handles deploy. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
Jordan (deploy-bot): deploy-bot: canary job started, job id 8942 — logs: http://ci.internal/jobs/8942/logs
Dan R.: Received logs link — will watch tests and report results here.
Samir: I'll hold releases until you say green, Dan.
Maria G.: Perfect. If anything urgent ping me directly.
